name: top-down-letters
title: Top-Down Letters
description: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase with zero blur.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Word that cascades in. Every character becomes one letter span, in source order.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Multiplies the drop the timeline drives, so the letters cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Letter colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
